visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a grey cap and black t-shirt sits at a red outdoor table on a balcony with a city skyline in the background. He holds a foil-wrapped Kinder Surprise egg towards the camera, presenting the brand logo clearly. (2) The camera moves to a close-up as the man's hands begin peeling the red, white, and blue foil off the egg, revealing the chocolate shell beneath. (3) He uses both thumbs to split the hollow chocolate egg in half, revealing a yellow plastic capsule nested inside. (4) He picks up the yellow capsule and pops it open with his fingers; small red plastic toy components fall out onto the table. (5) A macro shot follows as he carefully assembles the small red dragon-like toy, fitting several interlocking pieces together with his hands. (6) After assembly, he shows the completed toy to the camera while holding the chocolate shell in his other hand. (7) He takes a bite of the chocolate egg, smiling and gesturing towards the viewer while talking. (8) A brief cutaway shows a woman with a blurred background making a 'praying' gesture and looking directly at the camera. (9) The man returns to the frame, sitting at the red table and gesturing with his hands as he continues his explanation.
